schema.description: version of this shape: a file of another version is migrated by a script, never guessed

address.description: where it is, as its author writes it

presentations.description: the first one is shown when nothing else is chosen

openingTypes.description: the house's kinds of windows and doors, defined once and placed already configured (§8b)

floors.description: floors made by the person (redesign.md §8): this home's own, and a copy of each of their kits it uses

wallTiles.description: wall tiles made by the person (redesign.md §8f): this home's own, and a copy of each of their kits it uses

settings.description: what the house's author set once and the tools start from (§8c)

setup.description: the new home's guided setup; absent for a home that never had one

products.description: the project's copy of every catalog product its items use (furnishing.md §6, stage 2): the home renders whatever happens to the catalog

inventory.description: everything in the house from the catalog, placed or not (furnishing.md §4–5)

groups.description: pieces selected and moved as one (furnishing.md §8)

sets.description: groups of pieces saved to be placed again (furnishing.md §2)

north.description: degrees clockwise from the sheets' "up" to true north (0 = drawn north up)

Site.description: Where the home stands: drives the sun's path

pxPerM.description: sheet units per metre: 100 for new sheets (units are cm)

image.description: the drawing laid on the sheet; absent for a plan drawn from measurements only

scale.description: scale written on the drawing, e.g. "1:200"

Sheet.description: A drawing's frame of coordinates and its scale; it knows nothing about floors

src.description: the file, by its name in the project

place.description: where the image lies on the sheet: its top-left corner at `at`, `scale` sheet units per image pixel, turned by `rotation` degrees clockwise about `at`. Calibrating or straightening moves the image, never the walls.

crop.description: the part of the image shown, in image pixels; the whole image when absent

scaledBy.description: how the drawing was put to scale, so what is traced on it measures true; absent: never, it lies at the size it was imported at (a guess) and the editor says so

ImageCrop.description: A rectangle of an image, in its pixels from its top-left corner

ImageScaling.description: How a drawing was put to scale: on a known length between two of its points (`metres`), or by the scale written on it (1:`ratio`) and the dpi it was scanned at. A better scan laid over it keeps it.

shortName.description: as a lift's button says it ("3", "-1"); `name` when absent

elevation.description: height of its floor above the ground, m

Area.description: A group of rooms, independent of levels and sheets

origin.description: the sheet point that becomes the plan's (0, 0) in metres

placement.description: real position in the site; null = detached (only an arranged presentation places it)

rooms.description: in the order the house is gone through

plates.description: the light switches' and sockets' plates on its walls (redesign.md §7)

stairs.description: the stairs that start on this plan (floor-plan-editor.md §8d)

annotations.description: dimension lines and notes for people: printed, ignored by the renderer

Plan.description: A region of a sheet laid on a level, with everything drawn on it

rotation.description: degrees, clockwise as seen from above

Placement.description: Where a plan really is: its origin in site metres, and how far it is turned

outdoorFloor.description: outdoor floors (balconies, landing) sit this far from the indoor ones

balconySlab.description: balcony slab under the outdoor floor

slab.description: the floor's structure from this plan's ceiling to the floor of the level above; absent, a typical 30 cm

MeasureSources<(\"ceiling\"|\"outdoorFlo.description: Where each of some measures comes from, by the measure's name; one not listed says nothing

MeasureSource.description: Where one of the house's measures comes from: typed by the person, or typical (of the house's era when it was chosen, else the usual one), an assumption said so wherever it shows

BuildEra.description: How a house was built, for the measures typical of it (`houseDefaults.ts` `ERA_MEASURES`, their sources in floor-plan-editor.md §8c)

shortName.description: where space is tight; `name` when absent

cadastral.description: designation written on the cadastral plan

use.description: what the room is for: the electrical norm's minimum sockets go by it (CEI 64-8); absent, not said yet

floor.description: a kind of floor, or one of the home's own floors by id (`floors`); absent: no floor chosen yet (the editor tells such rooms apart by a hue of their own, redesign.md R9)

floorAngle.description: the direction its strips run, degrees from the sheet's x (0 = east–west, 90 = north–south): a parquet's, and added to a floor of the home's own direction

paint.description: painted walls; every other wall is white

wallTiling.description: its walls' tiled areas (redesign.md §8f), over the paint

views.description: the ways of looking at the room from above, the first being the overview it opens with

RoomId.description: A room's id: the name used at home and by the devices that name it (external)

RoomShape.description: The region the plan's walls (separators and railings included) enclose around `at`

RoomUse.description: What a room is for, as the electrical norm's table names them (CEI 64-8, part 3, annex A)

FloorKind.description: parquet, gres, concrete: indoor · outdoor: balconies, a step down, no ceiling · common: the shared landing

FloorRef.description: One of the home's own floors, by its id (`HomeModel.floors`)

RoomPaint.description: The room's walls painted, each on its face towards this room (a wall shared by two rooms has two faces)

WallTiling.description: An area of a room's walls laid with tiles, on their faces towards the room (redesign.md §8f), from `bottom` up to `top`: a bathroom's walls to 1.20 m, a shower's to 2.10 m, a kitchen's splashback between the worktop and the wall units

WallTilingSpan.description: Where along the walls: whole faces, or a stretch of one wall

WallTilingTop.description: Up to a height (m above the floor), or the ceiling, wherever the storey puts it

elevation.description: degrees above the horizon; the camera's default when absent

RoomView.description: One way of looking at a room: `dir` is the horizontal direction from the room towards the camera (x east, z south); `lower` the walls lowered so they don't hide the room.

sagitta.description: sheet units; how far the middle of the line bulges to the left of a → b (y down); 0 or absent: straight

height.description: m; full storey height when absent

Wall.description: A wall: its centre line from `a` to `b`, straight or an arc. A railing's line is the outer edge of the slab it stands on (its kerb lies inside it); a separator has no body, it only divides two rooms of one open space.

kind.description: a passage is a doorway with no frame and no leaf

along.description: where it runs along its wall's centre line, sheet units from the wall's end `a`

leaves.description: number of sashes (default: 2 if wider than 90 cm)

knx.description: shutter entity in the KNX bridge

type.description: the house's opening type it is (`openingTypes`); its leaves, frame, glazing, sills and shading come from it

inside.description: which side of its wall is its inside, walking the wall a → b; worked out from the rooms when absent (the side with an indoor room)

position.description: where the frame sits in the wall's thickness

overrides.description: what this opening has of its own, over its type's (or over its kind's defaults when it has none)

hinge.description: the side its hinges are on, seen from inside

opens.description: into the room (in) or out of it

share.description: its share of the opening's width, 0–1; leaves without one share what is left equally

box.description: a roller shutter's box: in the room, on the façade, or hidden in the wall

panels.description: shutters' panels (hinged or sliding ones only): slatted, or solid wood (Italian "persiane" and "scuri")

ShadingKind.description: The layers that shade an opening: outside the glass, then inside it

knx.description: cover entity in the KNX bridge; absent until it is bound

side.description: which face it hangs on, walking the wall a → b (y down)

along.description: its width along the wall, sheet units from the wall's end `a`; it may reach past the wall's ends

depth.description: m, from the wall's face to the outer edge

hWall.description: m above the floor, at the wall and at the outer edge

Awning.description: A motorised sun awning, hanging on a wall's face

rotation.description: degrees, clockwise about the rectangle's centre

Item.description: A plain block: a cladding or a piece of furniture not yet a catalog product

kind.description: a bare bulb on a cable from the ceiling

drop.description: from the ceiling to the bulb, m

entity.description: the device that drives it (a Home Assistant entity or a KNX bridge id); absent until it is bound
the device that drives it (a Home Assistant entity or a KNX bridge id); absent until it is bound
the device that drives it (a Home Assistant entity or a KNX bridge id); absent until it is bound
the device that drives it (a Home Assistant entity or a KNX bridge id); absent until it is bound

kind.description: an LED strip from `a` to `b`, at any angle

height.description: measured from the floor, or down from the ceiling

facing.description: where it shines: up, down, or to the left or right of a → b (y down)

entity.description: the device that drives it (a Home Assistant entity or a KNX bridge id); absent until it is bound

LightFixture.description: A light fixture, tied to the house entity that drives it

entity.description: what it drives, for the host apps (a Home Assistant entity or a KNX bridge id); absent: not said

side.description: the face it is on, walking the wall a → b (y down): the room it faces is that side's

along.description: where its centre is along the wall's centre line, sheet units from the wall's end `a`

height.description: m, from the finished floor to its centre; absent: the house's for its kind (`settings.plates`)

series.description: its series and colour as the author writes them ("BTicino Living Now · bianco"); a catalog product later

side.description: the face it is on, walking the wall a → b (y down): the room it faces is that side's

along.description: where its centre is along the wall's centre line, sheet units from the wall's end `a`

height.description: m, from the finished floor to its centre; absent: the house's for its kind (`settings.plates`)

series.description: its series and colour as the author writes them ("BTicino Living Now · bianco"); a catalog product later

Plate.description: A plate on a wall's face (redesign.md §7): a light switch's or a socket's

SwitchType.description: A light switch's plate: a simple switch, a two-way one, a push button, a shutter's up and down

PlateModules.description: How many module places a plate has

SocketType.description: A socket's plate: the Italian 10/16 A one, a Schuko, USB, the aerial's, a data network's

Stair.description: A stair climbing from its plan's level to another: of runs, or a spiral

path.description: the walking line on the sheet, from the first riser to the last, in the direction it climbs

turn.description: what fills each turn: a landing, or winders (three steps a quarter turn)

risers.description: how many risers; absent, as few as keep each one under 18 cm of the height it climbs

RunStair.description: A stair of runs (§8d): its shape is its walking line, 2 points straight, 3 an L, 4 a U, its turns square

opening.description: round its opening on the level above, but where it arrives; not said, a railing

StairGuards.description: A stair's guards; a side not said is worked out (a railing where it is not against a wall)

StairGuard.description: What guards a side of a stair, or its opening above: a slim railing, a low wall, nothing

radius.description: to the outside of its treads, m

start.description: where the first riser is, degrees from east, clockwise on the sheet

sweep.description: how far round it climbs, degrees, + clockwise on the sheet; a whole turn at most

risers.description: how many risers; absent, as few as keep each one under 18 cm of the height it climbs

SpiralStair.description: A spiral stair round its column (§8d)

at.description: a point of the sheet the dimension line runs through: where it is drawn, not what it measures

measured.description: taken on site: what the tape said, m, and the day (YYYY-MM-DD); the plan must keep agreeing with it

at.description: where it is pinned on the sheet

mode.description: true: every plan at its real placement; arranged: each area moved by its own offset

Presentation.description: Which areas are shown together, and where

offset.description: arranged only: how far the area's plans move from their placement, m

WalkStart.description: Standing at `from`, looking towards `towards`: sheet units of `plan`

position.description: where the frame sits in the wall's thickness

name.description: the author's name for it ("Finestra standard")

OpeningType.description: One of the house's kinds of windows or doors: placed already configured, its size the starting one

name.description: the author's name for it ("Rovere a spina")

kind.description: what it is, for what follows from it: an outdoor floor a step down and open to the sky

kit.description: a copy of one of the author's kits: its id and the version copied (a newer one is proposed, never imposed)

tile.description: m: a piece's length and width; a hexagon is as wide across its flats as both (the parser asks them equal)

direction.description: degrees, the pieces' length turned from the region's x (a floor: the sheet's; a wall: along it)

variation.description: how much one piece's shade may differ from the next, 0–0.5

product.description: the product it is, as the author writes it ("Marazzi Treverk 10×60"); a catalog product later

FloorDefinition.description: A floor made by the person (redesign.md §8, R13): its laying and what kind of floor it is. Kept in the home (only this home's, or the copy of one of the author's kits, with the kit's id and the version copied)

LayingMaterial.description: What every piece of a laying shows: an image uploaded (its file by sha256), a sample, or a plain colour

MaterialSample.description: The photos of materials Blupinta offers to lay pieces of, named by how they look: each a CC0 texture of Poly Haven's (`apps/web/public/floor-samples`, where each comes from is said there)

LayingPattern.description: How a laying's pieces are set out (`laying.ts`)

name.description: the author's name for them ("Bianco lucido 10×20")

kit.description: a copy of one of the author's kits: its id and the version copied (a newer one is proposed, never imposed)

tile.description: m: a piece's length and width; a hexagon is as wide across its flats as both (the parser asks them equal)

direction.description: degrees, the pieces' length turned from the region's x (a floor: the sheet's; a wall: along it)

variation.description: how much one piece's shade may differ from the next, 0–0.5

product.description: the product it is, as the author writes it ("Marazzi Treverk 10×60"); a catalog product later

WallTileDefinition.description: Wall tiles made by the person (redesign.md §8f): their laying, as a floor's but with no kind. Kept in the home as floors are (only this home's, or the copy of one of the author's kits)

era.description: how it was built: the measures typical of it are offered (the wizard's measures)

walls.description: m: the thickness new outer and inner walls start with

roomFloor.description: the floor a new indoor room starts with

toolTypes.description: the house's type (one of `openingTypes`, of that kind) each opening tool starts with

plates.description: m, from the finished floor to a plate's centre: where new light switches and sockets go (`housePlates`)

MeasureSources<(\"outer\"|\"inner\")>.description: Where each of some measures comes from, by the measure's name; one not listed says nothing

MeasureSources<(\"switchHeight\"|\"socke.description: Where each of some measures comes from, by the measure's name; one not listed says nothing

isFinished.description: the guided setup was gone through (or skipped to its end): it no longer opens by itself

isChecklistHidden.description: the checklist of next steps put away; it is shown again from the house's settings

version.description: bumped on any change that can move or reshape an item

category.description: a path in the shared taxonomy: "storage/shelving", "lighting/pendant", "decor/wall-art"

variants.description: option combinations the maker sells under its own article number

size.description: width (x), height (y), depth (z) as expressions of the options, m

clearances.description: the space it needs in use, beside its sides (furnishing.md §8): drawers pulled out, a door's swing, a chair

bindings.description: what in it a house entity can drive

source.description: the product sheet or the measurement it comes from

Translated.description: App content, shared by every user: in each of the app's languages (furnishing.md F5)

choices.description: each with numbers the expressions read as `<option>.<name>` (KALLAX's `size.cols`)

Condition.description: Shows (or allows) an option only when another holds one of some values

materials.description: the library's materials it is sold in

aspect.description: width over height of the picture's place

panels.description: a picture cut across panels (a multi-panel canvas), with the gap between them, m

count.description: how many slots, as an expression of the other options (KALLAX's cells)

ModelChoice.description: A model and the options that choose it; one without `when` is the fallback

When.description: Option values that must all hold: a choice's or a material's id, a number, yes or no

ModelRef.description: A model of the catalog: its bytes' sha256, and the file it is published from (`pnpm catalog:assets`)

at.description: where the part's box starts: its left, bottom, back corner, from the product's origin (floor, middle, back)

count.description: how many, an expression; 0 leaves it out (an option switching a part off)

index.description: the name each copy's number (0, 1, …) goes by in the part's expressions

name.description: what the part is ("drawer 1"), for clearances and, later, animation

at.description: where the part's box starts: its left, bottom, back corner, from the product's origin (floor, middle, back)

count.description: how many, an expression; 0 leaves it out (an option switching a part off)

index.description: the name each copy's number (0, 1, …) goes by in the part's expressions

name.description: what the part is ("drawer 1"), for clearances and, later, animation

Triple.description: Three expressions of the options, m: x, y, z or w, h, d

MaterialRef.description: A part's finish: what a material option holds, or a material of the library

side.description: the side it opens out of, as the product faces: across its whole width on the front or back, its depth on a side

depth.description: how far out, m, as an expression of the options

source.description: where the measure comes from: the product sheet, a measurement, a usual allowance

ClearanceUse.description: What a clearance is kept free for, named in the editor's warnings

product.description: the product and the version it was placed with: a newer one is offered, never forced

label.description: the author's own name for it ("Libreria studio"); the product's name when absent

room.description: the room it belongs to, placed or not

placement.description: where it stands; null: in the inventory, not placed yet

bindings.description: a house entity driving one of the product's binding slots

OptionValue.description: One option's value: a choice's or material's id, a number, yes or no, each slot's choice, a picture, a text

ImageValue.description: A picture in an image option: a file of the project and the part of it shown (fractions of its size)

pieces.description: two or more pieces of the inventory
